title: The Long Career of Richard Riehle

beats.text: Richard Riehle has died at age 78, leaving behind a career of over 400 projects.
Born in Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin, he later attended the University of Notre Dame.
An MFA at the University of Minnesota prepared him for his first major film roles.
His early work included a role in the film Rooster Cogburn, marking his entry into the industry.
Richard played the self-described people person Tom Smykowski in the film Office Space.
Television audiences recognized him as Walt Finnerty on Grounded for Life from 2001 to 2005.
He also appeared in the 1999 Tony-nominated revival of The Iceman Cometh on Broadway.
A body of work that spanned from 1977 until his passing in 2026 remains.
